question: Who is the cabinet minister of the Union Ministry of Education, as of September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dharmendra Pradhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dharmendra Pradhan is the **Union Cabinet Minister for Education** in the Government of India as of September 2024.
 
• He has held the position since **July 7, 2021**, after a cabinet reshuffle by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• In addition to education, Dharmendra Pradhan is also responsible for the **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**.
 
• He has played a pivotal role in implementing the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, focusing on holistic and multidisciplinary education reforms.
 
• Previously, he served as the Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas, where he was instrumental in initiatives like the **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**

 
 
• The NEP 2020 aims to transform India's education system, emphasizing early childhood care, foundational literacy, and skill development.
 
• It introduces a **5+3+3+4 structure**, replacing the previous 10+2 structure, focusing on flexibility and multidisciplinary education.
 
• Key aspects include vocational training from Grade 6, increased use of regional languages, and fostering critical thinking.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Education:**
 
 
• Previously known as the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), it was renamed in **2020** under NEP reforms.
 
• The ministry is responsible for formulating policies to improve school and higher education in India.
 
 
 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan's Background:**
 
 
• He is a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and hails from Odisha.
 
• He has a strong political career with extensive experience in governance and public administration.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship:**
 
 
• This ministry focuses on enhancing employability through skill training and entrepreneurship development initiatives.
 
• It collaborates with the education ministry for skill integration into formal education under the NEP.
